name: Cáseda (Spain)
description: Crimson-pink red field charged at the centre with the arms of Cáseda (a castle and a lion on red, timbred with a helmet and mantling).
history: Municipal flag of Cáseda; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
